title: Urine Sample Collection From Non Pregnant Peri and Post-menopausal Women
brief_summary: This is a sample collection study, participants will be required to collect one (if last menstrual period ≥12 months) or two (if last menstrual period \<12 months) urine samples and return them to the study site, together with collection sample information. Participants having a menstrual cycle within the last 6 months will also be required to provide follow-up information on pregnancy status and date of next menstrual bleed.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Known to be not pregnant,
* Willing to give consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnant or breastfeeding,
* Pregnant within last 2 months,
* Having treatment for infertility,
* Taken hormonal contraception containing hCG in last month,
* Using hormonal contraception within last month,
* Previously taken part in sample collection study for SDP (providing 1-7 samples).
